description.value:
Make a ranged tech attack against a creature within range. On a hit, it takes 2d8 poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of your next turn.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 per slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
